contract.purpose: RolePatch helps job seekers prepare a resume for a specific role by connecting the job requirements to supplied experience and showing a reviewable patch.

contract.job: Connect an assistant through standard OAuth with explicit account consent in existing optional Settings controls.
contract.thesis: Extend the approved Settings connection panel with its login/consent states; no new page, workspace, typography, color or composition.
